name: stats-section
purpose: The proof-by-numbers band of a marketing page: a framed row of big figures, each with its caption and optional prefix or unit. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'stats-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `registration-frame` and `stats`, which owns the figures' scale and layout.
useWhen: Use StatsSection for a band of proof figures placed from page JSON.
Rendering page JSON, or you need a whole band with no custom content → the section (`stats-section`). Building an SFC by hand, needing slots, or nesting inside another band → the primitive (`stats`).
To state reach, scale or results in three to five figures right after a hero or a claim.
avoidWhen: For figures that need a quote or a logo beside them → use `network-section` or `logo-wall-section`.
For a single figure inside another band → use `stats` directly.
related: `stats` — the figure row this band frames.
`network-section` — the band that pairs claims with client outcomes.
bestPractices: Keep `value` short and the unit in `suffix`, so the figure reads at a glance.
Three to five items; more than that and the figures stop reading as a band.

props.name: items
props.doc: The figures rendered as cells, in order; each item is `{ value, label, prefix?, suffix? }` where `value` is the figure, `label` its caption, and `prefix` / `suffix` the qualifier and unit set beside it.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.
